Updated the paste button to automatically trigger translation or rewrite after pasting. When you click the Paste button:

1. The text is pasted into the input field
2. After a short delay (150ms), it automatically runs translation (in translate mode) or rewrite (in rewrite mode)

This works regardless of the real-time translation setting. The delay ensures the input state is updated before processing.
